name: architect-engineers-reviewer
description: U-shape: one architect plans, parallel engineers implement separate tracks against that plan, a reviewer reads the merged output and judges cohesion. Use when a problem decomposes into independent parts that share a single design but need cross-checking at the end. The plan is `as`-bound so each engineer sees it; the reviewer sees both the plan and the joined engineer output.

phases.name: architect
phases.prompt:
Turn this request into a concrete plan. List the independent workstreams (3-5) — each one a self-contained chunk an engineer can pick up without coordinating with the others. State the success criteria for each:

${input}
